item.title: Katz threatens to seize Lebanon land if Hezbollah fire persists
item.description: Defense minister says military preparing to expand operations in Lebanon and warns that if Beirut fails to stop Hezbollah attacks on northern Israel, Israeli forces will take territory to restore security

item.title: Iran missiles trigger sirens across greater Jerusalem, all intercepted
item.description: Air defenses intercept missiles launched toward greater Jerusalem, the Shfela and the Jordan Valley on Thursday morning, with no injuries reported, as emergency teams check reports of a road impact near Har Gilo and interceptor debris in Mamilla

item.title: Israel says cracks forming in Iran’s military chain of command
item.description: After almost two weeks of war, officials say Iran’s forces are showing weaker coordination, lower motivation and sharply reduced launch rates, even as the Israeli Air Force expands strikes on military industries, missile launchers and Basij headquarters

item.title: Israel shifts to Gaza-style defense in Lebanon as IDF pushes fight beyond border to protect northern towns
item.description: Reservists operating inside southern Lebanon say the goal is to keep Hezbollah threats away from Israeli communities by pushing the front line deeper into enemy territory as the military prepares for a prolonged campaign

item.title: How Israel lost the element of surprise against Hezbollah as war with Iran reshaped the battlefield
item.description: IDF had prepared a surprise strike against Hezbollah leadership and rocket units, but political delays and the war with Iran shifted resources and cost Israel the element of surprise as tensions along the Lebanon border escalate

item.title: 'Be safe, strike hard': cockpit audio offers glimpse of US-Israeli mission over Iran
item.description: 'It is a great honor for us to fight with you': IDF releases radio traffic showing Israeli, US pilots exchanging praise, as both countries say their air forces operate in full coordination over Iran

item.title: Heavy fire from Lebanon, Iran raises stakes for Israel as war set to expand
item.description: Waves of fire from Lebanon and Iran send Israelis to shelters across the country; senior official says broad campaign in Lebanon near and reservists would be mobilized

item.title: Trump says 'practically nothing left' to strike in Iran, but officials brace for more fighting
item.description: US president says war will end whenever he decides, even as US and Israeli officials privately prepare for at least two more weeks of fighting and Netanyahu says conflict could last several more weeks

item.title: בארה"ב מעריכים: המשטר באיראן רחוק מקריסה
item.description: המודיעין האמריקני מעריך כי המשטר עדיין יציב, אחרי כמעט שבועיים של מלחמה. בכיר ישראלי אמר לרויטרס כי בישראל מודים שאין ודאות שהמלחמה תוביל לנפילת המשטר. אחד הגורמים ששוחחו עם סוכנות הידיעות ציין שכנראה תידרש פעולה קרקעית, שתאפשר לעם האיראני לצאת להפגין

item.title: איפה נופלים הטילים? האתרים שמציגים בזמן אמת את מפת המלחמה עם איראן
item.description: עוד לפני מבצע "שאגת הארי", נולד בישראל אקוסיסטם של מפות והתרעות שמרכז בזמן אמת נתוני שיגורים, יירוטים ושיבושי GPS. יוזמות עצמאיות ואתרי חדשות מציגים לציבור מידע שבעבר היה שמור לחמ"לים צבאיים בלבד. בעולם של איומים מתמשכים, הדאטה הפך לכלי הישרדות של ממש
